caption: The drawing depicts a single object that appears to be an ornate vertical panel or shield-like plaque rendered in shades of muted gold and brown. It is symmetrically shaped with a wider base that gently curves outward at the bottom corners, then rises with slightly tapered sides, leading up to a decorative finial at the top consisting of circular and spiral motifs. The main portion of the object features a series of decorative, linear, and curvilinear patterns, including scrolls, wavy lines, and foliage-like forms. The design includes two horizontally aligned, shell-like embellishments on either side just above the midpoint of the object. The background is plain and off-white, and the drawing has a signature on the lower left, "Albert Krems." The entire composition is centralized on the page with no additional objects present.
title: Patch Box of Kentucky Rifle
